name: MKT_IMP_ERRORS
description: Interface table for storing error messages received during import.

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Error id is a unique number to identify a row in the error table.  It is also the primary key for the table.

columns.name: ERROR_SUPPLEMENTARY
columns.description: Supplementary error details, which may contain stack-trace.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAILS
columns.description: Detailed error which will be appended to the TOKEN3_VALUE.

columns.name: COLUMN_NAME_CONTEXT
columns.description: It will capture additional context information to identify the matching column  header.

columns.name: MESSAGE_PRODUCT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the product code which logged the error or warning. It will be used in conjuction with column message_name.

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of error logged, for example 'ERROR' or 'WARNING'

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Attribute to capture error messages from ADF/HCM/WS

columns.name: INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the interface table for which the error row is captured.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch id links the error back to a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Interface row id links the error back to a row in the interface table.  Interface table name, batch id, and interface row id combination will point to the exact row in the interface table that is linked to the error.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Message name as defined in FND.  This will be used to get the translated message text in the error report.

columns.name: TOKEN1_NAME
columns.description: Token name as needed by the message.

columns.name: TOKEN1_VALUE
columns.description: Token value will be substituted for token name.  These will be displayed on the error report.

columns.name: TOKEN2_NAME
columns.description: Token name as needed by the message.

columns.name: TOKEN2_VALUE
columns.description: Token value will be substituted for token name.  These will be displayed on the error report.

columns.name: TOKEN3_NAME
columns.description: Token name as needed by the message.

columns.name: TOKEN3_VALUE
columns.description: Token value will be substituted for token name.  These will be displayed on the error report.

columns.name: TOKEN4_NAME
columns.description: Token name as needed by the message.

columns.name: TOKEN4_VALUE
columns.description: Token value will be substituted for token name.  These will be displayed on the error report.

columns.name: TOKEN5_NAME
columns.description: Token name as needed by the message.

columns.name: TOKEN5_VALUE
columns.description: Token value will be substituted for token name.  These will be displayed on the error report.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SYSTEM_TASK_ID
columns.description: System task id of the import activity execution

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Record number indicator in the file
